notes: Be aware that Voice of the Berserker, Strength of Nature, Regrowth and Regrowth of the Grove will block this effect. AKA "wort pot". This self-healing potion is important for end-game raiding guilds on difficult encounters where large amounts of damage are taken, or when the number of healers is lacking. Though expensive, repeated use of wort potions can keep a player alive through punishing area of effect spells and deadly flurries. Each wort pot can effectively extend a player's HP pool by 2700 if the last charge is saved for vendor recharge. Compare to Soulfire and Reaper of the Dead.

name: Bone Chips
merchant_value: MAX VALUE TO VENDOR 0 Platinums 0 Golds 1 Silvers 5 Coppers
notes: Bone Chips are used as a spell reagent by Necromancers and Shadow Knights to summon their pets. All such spells require two chips except Cavorting Bones which requires one. Bone Chips are also used in numerous quests for low level players to gain experience up to level 4 or so, the same quests may be used by higher level players for faction. Being accessible to low level players and time-consuming to farm by high level players, there will always be an economy for Bone Chips, giving low level players access to quick cash.

notes: A fun powerleveling tool up to level 18 or so since the right-click can be activated by a level one character. Not all weapons are usable by pets, because pets ignore weapon delay (so certain very high damage weapons would be too powerful). Options players have tested include: Weapon Damage 75 71 71 69 67 61 (NO RENT)61 61 61 53 47 40's 30's 14 ? Also, a set of Banded Armor or the junk armor from Droga, and a pair of Platinum Fire Wedding Ring, can get further mileage from the pet. A Muzzle of Mardu from a 56+ Magician (for haste) is also highly recommended. Players have reported success using the brazier in the following zones: * Befallen - Not recommended: Gynok Moltor (kills pet) spawns rarely near entrance, then paths through * Blackburrow - Beware of trains * Field of Bone * Misty Thicket * North Ro * Steamfont - At the minotaur camp * The Warrens * Upper Guk - only recommended if you know the zone well * other zones where you don't have to worry about (pet-killing) trains

name: Essence of Moonlight
notes: Seems to have a drop rate of about 1 in 10 from undead (white haired vampire females that are hunched over) in Mistmoore Castle. Given that the undead are only up for a bit less than half the day, this makes Essence of Moonlight annoyingly difficult to come by in any quantity. Soloing as a 50 cleric, I'm happy if I get two an hour, because oftentimes it's none. Go to Mistmoore Castle locations # 6,7, & 9 (Loc Mistmoore Castle| -67, 171) on the map and there are usually white haired vampire females regardless of it being day or night. Kill all the mobs in this area and when night time comes, include going to locations #10,11, & work back to 5 (doors that all open by the graveyard false wall). Work this and you will get drops and increase your drop rate. I get 2-3 drops in an EQ game day like this as a 60 enchanter. I just Soothe (Lull line of spells) by anything I don't want to mess with and level 55 pet with big haste cleans up anything I do run into or want to kill. Don't sit unless an area is clear of you can/will get aggro from nearby mobs.

name: Gnoll Pup Scalp
notes: NOTE: These have been confirmed to drop in all three zones - North Qeynos, Blackburrow and Everfrost Peaks. For monks looking to do the White Headband Quest, there are two spawns in North Qeynos at 1255, 922 and 1177, -260. They will spawn at these locations and begin wandering around the zone and have a 6 minute 40 seconds respawn. Two more spawn near the exit to Qeynos Hills inside Blackburrow and these are static spawns but they are on a much longer, 22 minute respawn. The newbie yard in Everfrost Peaks also has gnoll pups and they share spawns with all the creatures that wander the areas between the Blackburrow entrance and the ramp to Halas. The scalps are a less than common drop, so be prepared for a tedious grind.

name: Hole Key
notes: 'Hole Key' This key grants access to The Hole zone (see Key Compendium for more information). == Faction Requirements == You will need Apprehensivly or higher with Heretics to buy the Hole Key from the merchant. You will also need Amiably faction or higher with Heretics to get the Bone Crafted Key. === Raising faction === * Kill kobolds in The Warrens: They give positive Erudin and Paineel faction. Just slaughter everything and check your faction with the Paineel guards til you get apprehensivly and ask for someone to start the lift for you. * Kill Erudin & Erudin Palace Guards (Sentinels) will raise your Heretics faction. ** The guards inside Erudin Palace will spawn a weak water elemental(300hp?) when they die, killing it will also give faction for a total of 2 faction hits. **Erudin City: 8 guards near the docks and in the city. **Erudin Palace: 3 guards path around the zone in room and 4 guards are inside the shops and bank in the basement. ***Beware of wandering guild masters while killing the guards inside the palace! ***Time needed to get from scowls to kindly with a 58 warrior and a 58 cleric was about 1 hour or 4-5 respawns. With kindly we could get a lift key to the city and buy the Hole Key from the merchant. ***Erudin Palace guards seem to give +45 Heretic Faction each, 25 minute timer.

name: Mortificator Staff
effect_detail: Mana Sink (Combat, Casting Time: Instant) at Level 30
notes: Vendors for 15p. Although not very impressive for use in grouping or soloing, especially early on, it can be invaluable in certain instances where there are no Enchanters to sieve a CH or gate raid target. Good damage ratios make this a serviceable shaman weapon at early levels for added dps, but the proc effect is useless against just about any mob as they're likely to be dead five times over by the time you can land enough procs to prevent them from CH-ing or gating. While it can be resisted, after Malo, several shamans using them in succession can successfully prevent mobs from gating or at a minimum reduce the number of CHs west waste dragons will perform. Also worth mention is that besides the Staff of Discord and Withered Totem of Widdershins, this is the only Shaman exclusive weapon that uses this item model; very fashionable.

name: Shark Skin
notes: Notes: In OoT, both reef and normal sharks go between sisters isle and the goblin island across from the dock. I recommmend sitting on the banks of the goblin island and waiting for sharks to pass by from the northernmost point. In Erud's Crossing, many sharks can be found off the west coast of the island (farther off from the sunken ship), as well as three stationary spawns by the sunken ship. However, the best place to farm these is at the Erudin docks: several spawns of a shark and a sand shark (the latter of which drops skin more often) are found near the docks, and when you manage to spawn a diseased shark and kill it, eight a young sharks will spawn, each of which can drop skins. Alternatively you can just camp named sharks in Kedge Keep. By the time you get a few rare items (especially if you go for a super rare item like the ) you should have collected lots of Shark Skin.

effect_detail: Dance of the Blade (Combat, Casting Time: Instant) at Level 46
notes: Singing Short Sword The effect (Dance of the Blade) is a full party buff that adds 55% haste, 30 Strength, and 30 attack. It lasts for 2 minutes 30 seconds and has a range of about 150 feet. The 1.8 all-instrument (including singing) modification will only apply if the weapon is equipped in the primary item slot until October 2001 in the timeline: As of the patch that introduced Target Group Buff (TGB), make sure to turn off TGB (/tgb off) or the effect will not land on you and your group. With the Singing Short Sword and an Instrument equipped, it will take the higher of the two into account for song mods. It does not combine their power. The Singing Short Sword does not modify mana regeneration with any song or discipline. This includes the Puretone discipline as well as any mana regeneration song (e.g. Cassindra's Chorus of Clarity, aka "mana pump"). Singing Short Sword instrument modifier works in the offhand at Chardok

effect_detail: Shiftless Deeds (Any Slot/Can Equip, Casting Time: 2.5) at Level 45
notes: Rechargeable for 5000p. This item is prized by Monks for its ability to generate significant aggro instantly; capped at 400 hate per charge and has a 2.5 cast time; and rip a target from a second puller's train. It is also especially favored by racing teams for its 250 range, which is longer than other items such as the Wooly Spider Silk Net and faster than the Antonian Javelin; It is now slower than Javelins due to the cast time. In addition to the above points, the effect itself is a 65% slow, which is the best available to any class besides Enchanters and Shamans (and Bards) (Bard slow spell caps at 35%). Changed from Instant to 2.5 second cast time with the April 19, 2020 patch.

name: The Butcherblock Hammer
effect_detail: Superior Healing(Combat, Casting Time: Instant)
notes: The Relic of Brell Serilis Obtained during a GM event. The history of this wonderful weapon is cloudy and somewhat confusing. It is said to have been created by the god Brell Serilis, Lord of the Underfoot and father of the Dwarves and Gnomes, among others. But the texts go on to say that the hammer was wielded by Dagnor the Butcher, an Ogre Warlord of the Rakthokian Kingdom, and the most ambitious king the Ogres have ever had. During the Age of Blood, Dagnor the Butcher gathered a mighty army of ogres and attacked Kaladim with hopes of destroying the Dwarven race and claiming the riches of their mines. It seems contradictory that the creator of the Dwarven race, Brell Serilis, would craft a mighty weapon and then give it to the largest threat the dwarves have ever known. Back to the story, it is most likely that after Dagnor was defeated in the First Ogre-Dwarven War the hammer was locked up inside the depths of Kaladim and very few were aware of it's existence. Recently, the dark elves infiltrated Kaladim and stole the magical box, which contained the hammer. Whether they knew the contents of the box or not is a mystery, but either way the dwarves were very upset to find it missing. They recovered the box, but learnt the key was being held by the Captain of the Dark Elves. The King choose an adventurer to be the Champion of Kaladim and charged them with retrieving the key and returning it. Upon returning the key after defeating the Captain, the Champion was awarded the contents of the box, which was the Butcherblock Hammer. This weapon imparts strength and wisdom to it's wielder, and is fabled to heal it's owner during battle.

name: The Crafty Tailor
notes: THE CRAFTY TAILOR Every summer in the vale we must face the insect season when the little buggers come in swarms to feast on our crops and march on our homes. This past summer my hubby returned home from a daily wander with a captured spiderling. I was at first appalled by the creature but my hubby placed it in a large wooden cage outside our home so that the insects could fly in and get caught in the webs and the spiderling could not get out. Each day the spider would tear down his web and discard the silk and soon I had a large amount of the material to dispose of. As I reached for my broom one day I stumbled and scraped my palms in the fall. I hurried to our cupboard for a bandage and to my dismay there were none in our home. That was when Bristlebane blessed me with a bit of his craftiness. Taking my trusty TAILORING KIT, I wove a spool of SILK THREAD from TWO bits of SPIDERLING SILK. Once I had TWO spools of SILK THREAD I wove a SILK BANDAGE and bound my injured palms. With so much silk at my disposal I quickly ran out of bags to store it in. Taking THREE spools of SILK THREAD I wove a SILK CORD and then made myself a SMALL BAG from the SILK CORD and a LOW QUALITY WOLF SKIN. In order to prevent myself from falling and injuring myself on the hard floors I used my remaining LOW QUALITY SKIN of wolves, cats, and bears and one SILK THREAD to fashion some LEATHER PADDING which I laid on the floors. I have since had a blacksmith friend of mine offer to purchase such padding for use in his crafting of platemail armors.

name: The Oblong Bottle
notes: This bottle is a ground spawn at the bottom of the Ocean of Tears at neg 1611, pos 2924 (near siren twin islands). Bryan McGee says, 'The oblong bottle is a legend. They say one drink and you're off to oblivion, but just before that you feel the best you've ever felt and relive all your finest memories in the blink of an eye. The last I heard, some guy by the name of Turgin Swillfod turned up in Freeport spouting that he had found it. He was never heard from again.' Trolon Lightleer says 'Yo, ho, in the merry old harbor of Sir D'lere. There lived a small man who lived in fear. Fear of the pawns and fear of the fish, but most of all fear of the bottle. One day as he sailed overseas, he encountered a spat. A lovely lady being harrassed by a buccaneer, tall and fat. He hid all his fear and yelled 'Let her go!' The buccaneer said that he would do so. 'I will do so if you can drink from this bottle, oblong and of weight, for twenty whole seconds. Will you test your fate?' So as the ship did thread the needle around a quarter to five, foolish Turgin drank, passed out and took a dive. Under went he and the evil bottle too. Now all should fear the bottle of ochre goo.'

name: Tooth of the Cobalt Scar
notes: Dragon Stone of the Cobalt Scar This item is found as a ground spawn inside the Dragon Ring in the Cobalt Scar at /loc (-1087, -1593, 296), a few hundred meters east of Skyshrine. It is required for the spells Circle of Cobalt Scar and Cobalt Scar Portal but not required for Translocate: Cobalt Scar. The caster as well as passengers must all possess the tooth in their bags or inventory for receiving the required spells; those who do not have the tooth are left behind. The Tooth of the Cobalt Scar is a "Master key" that allows you to port to Wakening Lands and Great Divide as well. Feel free to destroy your other teeth when you have this one. Like the Trakanon Idol and Key to Charasis, this is a so-called soulbound item, which means it appears in your inventory after death and doesn't appear on your corpse.

name: Tooth of the Great Divide
notes: 'Dragon Stone of the Great Divide' This item is found as a ground spawn inside the Dragon Ring in Great Divide. It is required for the spells Circle of Great Divide and Great Divide Portal. The caster as well as passengers must all possess the tooth in their bags or inventory; those who do not have it are left behind. The Tooth of the Wakening Lands will also work for Great Divide teleportation; and the Tooth of the Cobalt Scar will work for all three. Feel free to destroy this tooth if you get either of the others. Like the Trakanon Idol and Key to Charasis, this is a so-called soulbound item, which means it appears in your inventory after death.

name: Tooth of the Wakening Lands
notes: This item is found as a ground spawn inside the Dragon Ring in the Wakening Lands. It is required for the spells Circle of Wakening Lands and Wakening Lands Portal. The caster as well as passengers must all possess the tooth in their bags or inventory; those who do not have it are left behind. The Tooth of the Wakening Lands also allows teleportation to the Great Divide as well. Feel free to destroy your Tooth of the Great Divide when you have this one. The Tooth of the Cobalt Scar works for all three. Like the Trakanon Idol and Key to Charasis, this is a so-called soulbound item, which means it appears in your inventory after death.
